units.source_text: 神志恢复过来的时候，男人发现自己还睡在女人的家里，心里真有些不痛快。

en.t: When he came back to his senses, the man realized that he was still asleep in the woman's house, and he felt genuinely displeased.

units.source_text: 村子里的家伙们甚至没有一点安慰他的表示。

en.t: The people in the village had not shown him even the slightest sign of comfort.

units.source_text: 他体会到这点，而自己这头也有打算。

en.t: He understood that, and he had plans of his own as well.

units.source_text: 他们连医生也不给叫，这边也就故意找麻烦，用出乎意料的方法，让对方觉得后悔。

en.t: Since they would not even call a doctor, he would deliberately make trouble too, using unexpected methods to make them regret it.

units.source_text: 女人半夜里干活的时候，自己呼呼大睡。

en.t: When the woman worked in the middle of the night, he would sleep soundly.

units.source_text: 相反，白天女人必须休息的时候，他就故意拼命地喊疼，不让女人好好睡觉。

en.t: Conversely, during the day, when the woman had to rest, he would deliberately cry out in pain with all his might, keeping her from sleeping properly.
